name: Harbour Room
description: A restful hideaway with a generous window seat and the softest morning light.
longDescription: Thoughtfully compact, with a reading corner, warm stone finishes and a view toward the old harbour roofs. Ideal for slow mornings and unhurried evenings.

name: Courtyard Room
description: Open the doors to a sheltered courtyard and settle into the calm.
longDescription: A private courtyard outlook, layered textiles and a walk-in shower give this room a residential feel. A good fit for travellers who want to take their time.

name: Coastline Studio
description: A light-filled studio with room to work, rest and watch the tide.
longDescription: The studio pairs a proper work table with a lounge nook, sea-facing windows and a compact pantry. It was designed for a longer change of scene.

name: Skyline Loft
description: A two-level loft framed by sculptural lines and expansive sky.
longDescription: Climb to an airy sleeping level while the lower floor stays open for conversation, reading or a small celebration. A flexible sofa bed welcomes a third guest.

name: Terrace Suite
description: A generous suite opening to a terrace above the waterfront.
longDescription: An outdoor terrace, separate sitting room and calming mineral palette make space for a special occasion without fuss. The suite accommodates three comfortably.

name: Sable Residence
description: Two bedrooms and a considered living space for sharing the coast.
longDescription: Our most spacious address brings two bedrooms, a dining table and a small kitchen together with sheltered harbour views. Designed for families or friends travelling together.
